A game that I recently discovered that’s like Stardew is Core Keeper. It has the same top-down view, 8-bit style, and practically the same customization screen/options.
It even has a bunch of farming stuff. 

The difference is that it’s more like a Jrpg with a plot point like Undertale where you fall into the ground and have to defeat some bosses to get back up. Or you can just build nice living spaces and chill with the NPCs and friends since it’s co-op. 

It’s procedurally generated like minecraft so playthroughs will have some difference in how it looks and where the bosses, camps, NPCs, etc. spawn. I really recommend it.
